surfaces.change: new record family: claude/changelog/<version>.json, required record_version (exactly 1), version, session_id, at, and a non-empty surfaces list of {path, change}
new library entry point validate_changelog_record(record) -> list of error strings ([] = valid); CHANGELOG_RECORD_SCHEMA and CHANGELOG_RECORD_VERSION constants
CLOSURE_REASONS gains 'aborted', so `bale unlock --reason` and `bale revert --reason` accept it
RELEASE_FILES gains schemas/changelog-record.schema.json (install.sh's INSTALL_LAYOUT and validate.sh's schema loop follow)

notes: First record of the family; versions before 0.4.35 are not backfilled.
